report.clinical_summary: Patient presents with a tender, newly developed (2-week) lymph node under the left jawline and fatigue of several months duration. Family history of CLL (father). No other lymphadenopathy, weight loss, or night sweats reported. Routine blood work last year was unremarkable. Patient takes a daily multivitamin and occasional ibuprofen. No CLL-specific medication initiated. Plan: blood work (CBC and relevant markers) plus ultrasound/biopsy of the lymph node. Follow-up Thursday at 10 am.
